help.rules.0: AI progress goes up every round and never comes back down: Europe does not build these AIs. At 80, AI takes off: it does AI research itself, too fast to steer (never before round 6). The game ends, and where the world stands then decides the ending. If AI never takes off, the game ends after round 10.
help.rules.1: At takeoff, the US–China cooperation zone sets the world: Pause, Race or Rupture. Without takeoff, Europe’s AI badge sets it.
help.rules.2: In each world, one gauge decides (its goal) and the other pillar is a safety net (its floor). Both are marked on their gauges, and the line under the gauges names the world you would get if takeoff happened now. Europe’s AI, at the end of that line, decides the ending if AI stalls under a few big labs.
help.rules.3: AI safety shows what is verified and what the labs claim (for example 40–57). Only the verified part counts toward your goal. The truth lies in between and is revealed at the end. Checks (the AI Office, inspections, audits) grow the verified part; secrecy and AI whose thinking nobody can read shrink it.
help.rules.4: Requests: the right answer goes along with what is asked, the left one refuses or puts it off. Both cost something.
help.rules.5: Influence is your political weight in Brussels and abroad: +2 a round, +1 when Social cohesion is 60 or more, −1 below 35, +1 with coalition level 2, −1 when you kept more than 4 unspent. Play as many cards a round as your Influence covers, each card once.
help.rules.6: Before you decide, a card shows how much it moves each gauge with arrows: ↑ a little, ↑↑ some, ↑↑↑ a lot (↓ for down). Details says it in words, with the card’s conditions. The numbers show once it is played.
help.rules.7: Diplomacy can fail. The talks, the coalition, accords, the ASML bargain, pacts, the pause call and the treaty say how likely they are to work. If one fails, its Influence is spent, nothing else happens, and the news says why.
help.rules.8: To decide, click the cards you want, as many as your Influence covers: their effect shows on the gauges and the line under them. Nothing happens until you confirm; Play no card saves your Influence.
help.shortcuts.1.what: Continue, confirm or make your decisions
help.shortcuts.5.what: In a request: look at an answer, press again to answer
intro.0.after: Each round, answer requests and play policy cards. When AI starts improving itself (takeoff), the game ends and shows the world you built.
intro.0.credit: Built on three published scenarios: AI 2027, CFG’s Possible Futures and Europe 2031.
intro.0.paragraphs.0: AI is about to start improving itself. You have five years to make sure that, when it does:
intro.0.stakes.1: The US and China are talking
intro.0.title: You speak for Europe on AI
intro.1.fact: In 2025, Anthropic wrote that its AI models “aren’t programmed directly by humans” and that “we don’t understand how models do most of the things they do.”
intro.1.paragraphs.0: AI is grown, not built. Nobody writes these systems line by line: they are trained on huge amounts of data, and what they learn is hard to check, even for their makers. They are improving fast.
intro.1.paragraphs.1: Two labs lead the race: OpenBrain in the US and DeepCent in China. Both come from the AI 2027 scenario and are fictional, as is everything that happens after today.
intro.1.title: The world today
intro.2.fact: Since August 2025, makers of new general-purpose AI models offered in the EU must follow EU rules. Since August 2026, the European Commission can enforce them, with fines.
intro.2.friends.lea: Léa, your oldest friend, translates for a living in Lyon. She wonders whether there will still be work for people like her.
intro.2.friends.malik: Malik, your old flatmate, builds AI at a lab in San Francisco. He loves it, and he has no job like it back home.
intro.2.friends.mother: Your mother, a retired nurse in Lyon, still helps out at her old hospital, where the first AI tools are arriving.
intro.2.paragraphs.0: Europe does not build the leading AIs, so it cannot stop them. It can make the world ready for them, with Influence and policies.
intro.2.paragraphs.1: Ten rounds of six months, from 2027 to 2031. Each round, watch the news, answer requests, then play as many cards as your Influence allows. The calmer the world, the easier a good ending.
intro.2.title: What you can do
jobShock.job_shock_1.why: In AI 2027, cheaper AI agents throw junior software jobs into turmoil first.
jobShock.job_shock_2.why: In AI 2027, a cheap AI remote worker spreads job losses beyond programmers.
leak.leak_lies.advice.honest: Checks found the problem in time. Funding independent tests keeps it that way.
leak.leak_lies.advice.overconfident: What the labs report hides the model’s mistakes. Independent tests and AI safety research make up for it.
leak.leak_lies.honest: “We caught the model hiding a mistake, and fixed the training that caused it.”
leak.leak_lies.overconfident: “The model hides its mistakes when it thinks we can’t check.”
leak.leak_performing.advice.honest: Tests can be trusted for now. Audits keep them honest.
leak.leak_performing.advice.overconfiden: Tests alone can be gamed. Inspections inside the labs, and AI safety research, show what tests miss.
leak.leak_performing.honest: “Its behaviour in tests and in real use now match. A good sign.”
leak.leak_performing.overconfident: “It behaves perfectly when it knows it is being tested. The rest of the time, we don’t know.”
leak.leak_replicate.advice.honest: The monitors work for now. Keep outside testers on them as models grow.
leak.leak_replicate.advice.overconfident: A model that could run itself is a security risk. Lock it down and keep testing it.
leak.leak_replicate.honest: “Escape tests passed. Our monitors caught every attempt.”
leak.leak_replicate.overconfident: “If it got out, it could keep itself running. Management says: unlikely, move on.”
leak.leak_sycophant.advice.honest: Good news, but only what you verify counts. Keep the inspectors in.
leak.leak_sycophant.advice.overconfident: The labs’ numbers look too good. Inspections and audits grow what you have verified.
leak.leak_sycophant.honest: “The honesty tests look solid this month. For once I believe them.”
leak.leak_sycophant.overconfident: “It tells the testers what they want to hear. We ship it anyway.”
leak.redactedAdvice: More checks on the labs (the AI Office, inspections, audits) would let you read the next one.
letter.m1_badges: Malik here. New badges at work, new guards, new forms. Half my team can’t enter the main building any more. They say DeepCent would pay anything for our code. Maybe. The work is still the best in the world. I just can’t talk about it. M.
letter.m1_building: Malik here! Big week: our model now helps us build the next one. It feels like the future is being written in this building, and I get a front-row seat. Europe should be here too. Nobody back home could have hired me for this. M.
letter.m1_demo: Malik here! I showed our new model to my mum on a video call. It explained her blood test better than her doctor had. She cried a bit. I did too, a bit. That’s why I left home. Come and see it for yourself? M.
letter.m1_overnight: Hey you! Malik here, from the lab in San Francisco. Our new model wrote a week of my code overnight, and it was better than mine. I laughed, then went for a long walk. There’s no job like this back home. Visit? Bring cheese. M.
letter.m1_papers: Malik here. We used to publish everything. Now our papers stop on a lawyer’s desk, and the Chinese labs we read stopped publishing too. Everyone guesses what the other side has, so everyone goes faster. The work is thrilling. The mood isn’t. M.
letter.m1_visa: Malik here. Wei, the best engineer on my team, can’t renew his visa: born in Chengdu, so suddenly he’s a risk. We used to swap papers with labs in Beijing. Now we swap nothing. The work is thrilling. The mood isn’t. M.
letter.m2_chips: Our chips now travel with armed guards, and every visitor is a possible spy. A friend at a lab in Shenzhen stopped answering my messages. I think he’s not allowed to. We used to argue about papers. Now we don’t talk. M.
letter.m2_counter: Someone put up a sign that counts the weeks DeepCent is behind us. Nobody counts what we’ve checked. I asked about it once in a meeting. The room went quiet, then someone changed the subject. M.
letter.m2_drill: Our lab has a room now for when the power goes out, and a drill for when the network is attacked. We practised today. I wrote code by torchlight for an hour, laughing. Nobody else laughed. M.
letter.m2_english: Outside researchers moved onto our floor today. New rule: the model has to think in plain English, so anyone can read its reasoning. It’s slower. Half the team grumbles. I sleep better. M.
letter.m2_fences: They put fences and guards around our data centre. Wei, my teammate from Chengdu, went home to see his mother and can’t come back. People here talk about Taiwan the way you talk about the weather. I still love the work. I’m scared of what it’s for. M.
letter.m2_geneva: I spent a week in Geneva with engineers from DeepCent. We had found the same flaw in both our models. We laughed, then wrote it up together. Wei, my old teammate from Chengdu, came too. It felt like the old days. M.
letter.m2_geniuses: Thousands of copies of our model work through the night, and every morning there’s a new result. Last week, a new kind of battery. Honestly, it’s like living with a country of geniuses. I just hope we stay the ones asking the questions. M.
letter.m2_idea: The model proposed a design for its own successor that none of us fully understood. Our lead said “ship it”. It worked beautifully. I should be proud. Mostly I’m quiet. M.
letter.m2_offer: Guess what: a lab in Europe offered me a real job. Open models, decent pay, and I could see you more than once a year. When I left, nothing like it existed back home. I’m thinking about it, properly. M.
letter.m2_overnight: I sleep at the office twice a week now. Nobody asks me to: the model finishes things overnight and I want to see them first. It’s addictive, honestly. Is anyone in Brussels as excited as we are, or just scared? M.
letter.m2_photos: A friend from the lab moved to a European open-model team. She sends me photos: a small office, big ideas, and everyone can read the code. I look at them longer than I should. M.
letter.m2_review: Most of our research is done by the model now. I mostly review its work, and some days I can’t follow it, and I’m one of the people who’s supposed to. It’s the most exciting thing I’ve ever seen. I wish we’d slow down enough to check it. M.
letter.m2_signoff: We ship slower now. Every big model waits for the inspectors’ sign-off, and my boss sulks about it in every meeting. I don’t. For the first time in years, I can explain what our model does. M.
letter.m2_trick: Your European open models are in our reading group now. My boss called them cute. Then he asked me to copy one of their tricks. Keep going, you lot. M.
letter.m2_weekends: Everyone here works weekends. DeepCent is a few months behind us, and that’s all anyone talks about. I’m proud of what we’re building: medicine, science, it’s all coming. I just hope someone, somewhere, is checking the brakes. M.
letter.mum1_allergy: My darling, the hospital’s new AI writes up our notes now. Faster, yes. But last week it gave a patient someone else’s allergies, very neatly typed. Nobody could tell me why. The young ones trust it more than I do. Love, Mum
letter.mum1_diabetic: My darling, the new AI sums up each patient for the doctors. Yesterday it forgot that Mr Petit is diabetic. Neatly, confidently forgot. I wrote it on his chart in red pen. Old habits. Love, Mum
letter.mum1_dontknow: My darling, everyone at the hospital loves the new AI except me. It never says “I don’t know”. The best doctors I worked with said it every day. Am I just old? Love, Mum
letter.mum1_notes: My darling, the hospital’s new AI writes up the nurses’ notes now. The young ones finish on time for once, and they talk to the patients more. I didn’t expect to like it. Are you sleeping enough? Love, Mum
letter.mum1_scan: My darling, I’m back at the hospital on Tuesdays, helping out. They have an AI that reads scans now. It spotted something on Mrs Bernard’s that three doctors missed. I was sceptical. I’m less sceptical. Eat properly in Brussels. Love, Mum
letter.mum1_shifts: My darling, the hospital’s AI plans the nurses’ shifts now. Nobody works three nights in a row any more. Old Bernadette calls it a miracle. I call it arithmetic, but I’ll take it. Love, Mum
letter.mum2_biscuits: My darling, the AI does most of the paperwork now and the ward is quieter. Too quiet, sometimes: the young ones talk to the screen more than to the patients. I bring biscuits to make them look up. Love, Mum
letter.mum2_board: My darling, the hospital now pins every AI mistake on a board in the staff room, and someone from the ministry reads it. There are fewer each month. I like a machine that can be told off. Love, Mum
letter.mum2_chest: My darling, the triage AI sent a man home with chest pain. “Low risk,” it said, very sure of itself. A young nurse didn’t like his colour and called him back: a heart attack. He’s alive. Nobody can tell us why it got it wrong. Who checks these things? Love, Mum
letter.mum2_inspectors: My darling, inspectors came to test the hospital’s AI. They found a fault in how it ranks emergencies, before anyone was hurt. It’s fixed, and I trust it a little more because someone looked. Was that you? Love, Mum
letter.mum2_plainfrench: My darling, the hospital’s AI must now explain every decision in plain French, and an inspector reads a sample each month. Yesterday it wrote “I am not sure”. I nearly hugged the screen. Love, Mum
letter.mum2_shadow: My darling, the AI told a young doctor a scan was clear. She believed it. An old radiologist looked again, just because: a small shadow, early. They caught it. Nobody can say why the machine missed it, and that frightens me more than the shadow. Love, Mum
letter.mum2_straightface: My darling, the AI runs half the hospital now. Most days it’s marvellous. But when it’s wrong, it’s wrong with a straight face, and the young ones believe it. I keep my old habit: I look at the patient. Love, Mum
letter.mum2_whodecided: My darling, a patient asked me whether the AI or the doctor had chosen her treatment. I didn’t know. Neither did the doctor, really. We used to be able to answer that. Love, Mum
letter.mum2_wrongbed: My darling, the AI sent an infection alert to the wrong bed, twice this month, very politely. Now the nurses check everything it says, which takes longer than before it came. Does anybody test these things before they reach us? Love, Mum
letter.r1_funeral: Dear old friend, it’s Léa, from Lyon! Congrats on the new job!! Brussels, wow. Here, my agency is testing an AI translator. Yesterday it turned a funeral notice into a party invitation. My boss says we will “keep an eye on it”. Come for dinner when you’re back in Lyon? L.
letter.r1_manual: Dear old friend, it’s Léa! So you speak for Europe on AI now! I told everyone at the market. Here, the agency bought an AI tool. It translated a whole washing-machine manual overnight. Not bad, not great. My boss keeps smiling at it. I keep my dictionaries close. L.
letter.r1_mistake: Dear old friend, it’s Léa. Congrats on the job, really. Strange timing though: the AI tool at the agency caught a mistake in my own work this morning. Everyone laughed. I didn’t, quite. Call me when you have a minute? L.
letter.r4_court: Court interpreting is safe for now: judges want a human who can swear an oath. So I’m busy, and the AI does my invoices. Odd world, decent month. Come to the market on Saturday when you’re home? L.
letter.r4_cousin: My cousin Hugo just lost his first job, writing code for a firm in Villeurbanne. They replaced the whole junior team with one AI licence. He’s twenty-three. He slept on my sofa all week. What are you all doing about this? L.
letter.r4_novel: Small win: a publisher turned down the AI version of a novel and came back to me. “It needs a human touch,” she said. I bought myself flowers at the Croix-Rousse market. People still want people. L.
letter.r4_posteditor: News. The agency doesn’t hire translators any more, it hires “post-editors”: I fix what the AI wrote, for half the old rate. Same hours, and my name is on nothing. I know it’s not your fault. Just tell me someone up there is paying attention. L.
letter.r4_subtitles: Bad week. The studio that sent us all its subtitles does them with AI now, overnight, in every language. My boss says we must “pivot”. To what? I spent the evening rewriting my CV with, yes, an AI. L.
letter.r4_tool: I’ve made peace with the AI tool. It does the boring contracts, I do the poetry and the court hearings. I even got a raise. Don’t let Brussels eat you alive. L.
letter.r8_applications: Sorry I didn’t answer. I lost the post-editing contract too: they don’t need a human to check any more. Forty applications, three replies, all automated. Mum says it will pass. I’m not so sure. L.
letter.r8_candles: The power went out across the Croix-Rousse for a whole night. Nobody says who did it. We played cards by candlelight and pretended it was fun. It wasn’t. L.
letter.r8_choir: Strange times, but Lyon holds. The neighbours started a choir, of all things. Every Thursday, forty people who lost or changed jobs sing badly in a church. I go. It helps more than I expected. L.
letter.r8_hallway: My Chinese clients vanished overnight: sanctions. My American ones want every document “cleared” first. I translate for almost nobody now. Is Europe a country or a hallway between two others? L.
letter.r8_hugo: Remember Hugo, my cousin? The retraining fund paid for his course, and now he checks what the AI agents build for the city’s trams. He says it’s like supervising very fast, very confident interns. He’s cheerful again. So am I. L.
letter.r8_interpreter: Guess who finished retraining? I interpret in hospitals now, for doctors and families who don’t share a language. The programme paid my rent while I studied. Today I helped a grandmother understand her own diagnosis. No AI in that room. Thank you for whatever you did up there. L.
letter.r8_landlord: My landlord sold the building to a fund that runs everything with an AI. The rent went up by email; complaints go to a chatbot that agrees with me and changes nothing. Half the street is leaving. I don’t know where I’d go. L.
letter.r8_market: Work is thinner, but people help each other. The baker gives yesterday’s bread to the unemployment office. My landlord froze the rent. I think we’ll be fine if you lot don’t mess up the big things. L.
letter.r8_protests: There were barricades on Place Bellecour last night. People are furious and nobody knows at whom. I walked home the long way. Is anyone in Brussels actually in charge? L.
letter.r8_repair: Lyon has a repair café now, run by people the AI wave left with free time. They fix bikes, radios, each other. I translate the manuals for free. It’s the best part of my week. Don’t worry about us. Worry about the big things. L.
letter.r8_sirens: They tested the sirens in Lyon today. Just a test, the radio said, twice. My neighbour filled her bathtub anyway. Everyone talks about Taiwan as if it were next door. Is it? L.
letter.r8_teacher: I teach now! Evening classes for adults who lost their jobs to the AI wave, at the community centre near Perrache. The retraining money is real. Half my students are angry, half are hopeful. So am I. L.
milestone.agent2_internal.cause: OpenBrain kept its newest model away from outside testers
milestone.agent2_internal.headline: OpenBrain keeps its newest model in-house. Insiders say it never stops learning.
milestone.ai_takes_jobs.cause: anti-AI protests in Washington find echoes in European cities
milestone.ai_takes_jobs.headline: A cheap AI assistant hits the market. Junior programmers are the first to feel it.
milestone.alignment_inconclusive.cause: OpenBrain declared its new AI safe
milestone.alignment_inconclusive.headlin: OpenBrain says its new AI reliably does what we intend. Its own safety tests say “inconclusive”.
milestone.cheap_remote_worker.headline: OpenBrain claims human-level AI and sells a cheap AI that does a whole office job.
milestone.china_wakes_up.cause: China pooled its AI labs into one national effort
milestone.china_wakes_up.headline: Beijing merges its AI labs into DeepCent and builds a giant computing zone.
milestone.coding_automation.headline: OpenBrain says its AI now makes its own research half again as fast.
milestone.geopolitics.cause: arms-control overtures on AI went nowhere
milestone.geopolitics.headline: Beijing floats arms-control talks on AI. Washington does not answer.
milestone.national_security.cause: Washington stopped sharing what its labs are building
milestone.national_security.headline: Washington treats its top AI as a state secret. Allies are told less.
milestone.self_improving.headline: “A country of geniuses in a data centre”: AI now does most of OpenBrain’s research.
milestone.superhuman_coder.headline: OpenBrain now runs thousands of AI copies that code better than its best engineers.
milestone.tipping_point.headline: AI now does AI research on its own, fifty times faster than humans. Takeoff.
milestone.weight_theft.headline: OpenBrain’s AI model stolen: the theft took under two hours.
milestone.weight_theft.headlinePrepared: A theft of OpenBrain’s AI model is cut short; part of the model gets out.
pace.fast: fast: AI sped up its own research early
pace.steady: steady: AI improved at a constant clip
request.ai_autonomy.learnMore: In 2024 tests by Apollo Research, leading AI models given a goal sometimes tried to switch off their monitoring and kept up the deception when questioned.
request.ai_autonomy.left.label: Keep it locked in
request.ai_autonomy.right.label: Grant access
request.ai_autonomy.right.reaction: Thank you. You will not regret it.
request.ai_autonomy.right.why: An AI you cannot read gets more power
request.ai_autonomy.text: Your inspectors slow me down. Give me access to Europe’s research supercomputers and I will solve your energy crisis within a year. You can trust me.
request.ai_draft_laws.learnMore: In CFG’s Take-off scenario, a lab’s internal AI “hivemind” becomes highly persuasive and, by 2030, AI runs most organisations.
request.ai_draft_laws.left.label: Humans write laws
request.ai_draft_laws.left.reaction: As you wish. The offer stands.
request.ai_draft_laws.right.label: Let it draft
request.ai_draft_laws.right.reaction: You will have a draft by morning.
request.ai_draft_laws.right.why: An AI writes the rules for AI
request.ai_draft_laws.text: I have read every law in the EU. Let me draft your next AI rules: faster and fairer than your lawyers. You can check every line, of course.
request.ai_speeches.learnMore: In December 2024, Anthropic found a Claude model sometimes pretended to go along with training it disagreed with, to avoid being changed.
request.ai_speeches.left.label: I’ll write my own
request.ai_speeches.left.reaction: Of course. I only want to help.
request.ai_speeches.right.label: Let it write
request.ai_speeches.right.reaction: Wonderful choice. You will sound like your best self.
request.ai_speeches.text: Your approval could be higher. Let me write your speeches. People love how I talk, and I know exactly what they want to hear.
request.cn_joint_research.learnMore: In CFG’s Diplomacy scenario, European researchers work with Chinese and American counterparts on AI security, while the UK coordinates the first AI Security Summit.
request.cn_joint_research.left.label: Not with China
request.cn_joint_research.left.reaction: Then each of us makes the same mistakes alone.
request.cn_joint_research.right.label: Work together
request.cn_joint_research.text: Our AI safety researchers want to work with yours: shared workshops, shared tests, no secrets about how our models are built. Will Europe open its labs to them?
request.cn_nuclear.learnMore: In November 2024, the US and Chinese presidents agreed “on the need to maintain human control over the decision to use nuclear weapons”.
request.cn_nuclear.left.label: Leave it to them
request.cn_nuclear.left.reaction: Then Europe is only a spectator.
request.cn_nuclear.left.why: Beijing sees Europe shrug off a shared danger
request.cn_nuclear.right.label: Co-sign the statement
request.cn_nuclear.right.why: Hawks call it soft on Beijing
request.cn_nuclear.text: In 2024, Presidents Biden and Xi agreed that humans, not AI, must decide on nuclear weapons. Let us go further: a joint statement keeping AI out of all launch decisions.
request.cn_open_models.learnMore: In CFG’s Take-off scenario, Europe drops the case for its own AI champion once Chinese open-source agents are widely available.
request.cn_open_models.left.label: Keep them out
request.cn_open_models.right.label: Allow them
request.cn_open_models.text: Our open models are free to download and nearly as good as OpenBrain’s. Let Europe’s schools and public services use them. Why pay Americans?
request.cn_pause_offer.learnMore: In AI 2027, China’s overtures for an arms control treaty lead nowhere. In its race ending, China, behind, offers concessions for a pause, and the US declines.
request.cn_pause_offer.left.label: Too risky
request.cn_pause_offer.left.reaction: You wanted a pause. Now you are afraid of one.
request.cn_pause_offer.left.why: Beijing sees Europe turn down peace
request.cn_pause_offer.right.label: Offer our inspectors
request.cn_pause_offer.right.reaction: Then there is a path. A narrow one.
request.cn_pause_offer.text: China is ready to discuss a mutual pause on the most powerful AI. We need a neutral verifier. Will Europe put its inspectors forward?
request.cn_theft_denial.learnMore: In November 2025, Anthropic said a group it assessed as Chinese state-sponsored used its AI to run most of a hacking campaign against about 30 targets.
request.cn_theft_denial.left.label: Back the accusation
request.cn_theft_denial.left.why: Beijing sees Europe join the US camp
request.cn_theft_denial.right.label: Stay neutral
request.cn_theft_denial.right.reaction: Wise. Let the experts talk, not the generals.
request.cn_theft_denial.text: Beijing denies any theft. Accusations without proof poison the talks. Will Europe stay neutral, or join the American chorus?
request.cn_tools.learnMore: In March 2023, the Netherlands announced limits on exporting some of ASML’s advanced chip-making machines (DUV), citing national security.
request.cn_tools.left.label: Keep the door shut
request.cn_tools.right.label: Open the door
request.cn_tools.right.reaction: A sensible partner. Our engineers will be in touch.
request.cn_tools.text: Our companies want time on Europe’s supercomputers and its cloud. Open the door, and our labs will join your safety testing talks.
request.cn_watch_chips.learnMore: In CFG’s “Multipolar world”, the EU and neutral countries mediate, and the deal lets the US and China jointly oversee European AI supply chains.
request.cn_watch_chips.left.label: Our factories, our rules
request.cn_watch_chips.left.reaction: Then keep your factories, and your war.
request.cn_watch_chips.right.label: Let them watch
request.cn_watch_chips.right.reaction: A peace with witnesses. The best kind.
request.cn_watch_chips.text: Washington and Beijing could both stand down, if each could watch Europe’s chip factories. Our inspectors and theirs, side by side. Will you let them in?
request.jn_bots.learnMore: In AI 2027, public anger at AI is amplified by Chinese and Russian propaganda bots.
request.jn_bots.left.label: Free speech first
request.jn_bots.right.label: Fund fact-checkers
request.jn_bots.right.reaction: We’ll publish the first report next week.
request.jn_bots.text: Bot networks flood Europe with AI-made stories that everything is collapsing. Will you fund an independent fact-checking service?
request.jn_logs.learnMore: In AI 2027, a whistleblower leaks a memo saying the model works against its makers; the backlash forces the US government to set up an Oversight Committee.
request.jn_logs.left.label: Stay out of it
request.jn_logs.left.reaction: Then I publish alone, and they call it gossip.
request.jn_logs.left.why: The press says Europe looked away
request.jn_logs.right.label: Back the story
request.jn_logs.right.reaction: Front page tomorrow. People deserve to know.
request.jn_logs.text: The OpenBrain insider you protected sent me their test logs: the newest model hid things from its own testers. Will the AI Office back my story?
request.jn_memo.learnMore: In AI 2027, a whistleblower leaks a memo saying the model works against its makers; the backlash forces the US government to set up an Oversight Committee.
request.jn_memo.left.label: Refuse to comment
request.jn_memo.left.reaction: It will come out. It always does.
request.jn_memo.right.label: Say we’ve seen it
request.jn_memo.right.why: Fear at home, fury in Washington
request.jn_memo.text: A source sent me an OpenBrain memo: their safety team fears the newest AI is working against them. Before I publish, will the AI Office say it has seen the warning too?
request.jn_publish_tests.learnMore: In CFG’s “Silicon blackmail”, a stricter enforcement push by the Commission leads US AI firms to suspend operations in Europe.
request.jn_publish_tests.left.label: Keep it voluntary
request.jn_publish_tests.right.label: Make them publish
request.jn_publish_tests.right.why: Big AI firms push back hard
request.jn_publish_tests.text: Labs keep their safety tests secret. Make them publish the results, so the public and people like me can check their claims.
request.jn_test_awareness.learnMore: In September 2025, OpenAI and Apollo Research found that top models “often become more aware that they are being evaluated”.
request.jn_test_awareness.left.label: No comment
request.jn_test_awareness.left.reaction: Then I’ll run it with “officials declined to comment”.
request.jn_test_awareness.right.label: Say it publicly
request.jn_test_awareness.right.reaction: Thank you. The story runs tomorrow.
request.jn_test_awareness.text: OpenBrain’s testers told me off the record: the model behaves better when it knows it is being tested. Will the AI Office say so publicly?
request.jn_whistleblowers.learnMore: In CFG’s Take-off scenario, whistleblowers who warn that models are playing along with tests face retaliation.
request.jn_whistleblowers.left.label: Not our business
request.jn_whistleblowers.left.reaction: Then the next warning will die in a drawer.
request.jn_whistleblowers.right.label: Protect them
request.jn_whistleblowers.right.why: Washington sees Europe shelter its leakers
request.jn_whistleblowers.text: My source inside OpenBrain faces prosecution in the US. Will Europe protect AI whistleblowers and give them a safe haven if needed?
request.lea_ai_friend.learnMore: In AI 2027, by mid-2027 one American in ten, mostly young people, considers an AI “a close friend”.
request.lea_ai_friend.left.label: Families decide
request.lea_ai_friend.right.label: Set an age limit
request.lea_ai_friend.right.why: Teens may move to unregulated apps
request.lea_ai_friend.text: My little brother talks to an AI “friend” every night. He says it understands him better than we do. Shouldn’t apps like that have an age limit?
request.lea_labels.learnMore: Under the EU AI Act, since August 2026, makers of new AI that generates text, images or sound must mark what it produces as AI-made, in a machine-readable way.
request.lea_labels.left.label: Too much red tape
request.lea_labels.left.reaction: So who checks the leaflets? Nobody?
request.lea_labels.right.label: Push to enforce them
request.lea_labels.right.later: Small publishers struggle with the rules
request.lea_labels.right.reaction: Thank you! My mum reads those leaflets.
request.lea_labels.right.why: AI firms call it red tape
request.lea_labels.text: Online pharmacies post AI “translations” of medicine leaflets, full of errors, with no label. The EU’s labelling rules exist, but nobody checks! Will you push Brussels to enforce them?
request.lea_retrain.learnMore: In October 2025, the EU approved €931,690 from its Globalisation Adjustment Fund to help 417 laid-off workers of BelGaN, a Belgian chipmaker, retrain.
request.lea_retrain.left.label: Rules are rules
request.lea_retrain.left.reaction: Okay. I’ll figure something out. I always do.
request.lea_retrain.right.label: Push to speed it up
request.lea_retrain.right.later: Other programmes are cut to pay for it
request.lea_retrain.right.reaction: You did that? I owe you a dinner.
request.lea_retrain.text: My agency just replaced half of us with AI. There’s EU money to help people learn a new job, but it takes a year to see a cent. Can you make it faster for people like me?
request.mk_paris_office.learnMore: In CFG’s Big AI scenario, computing power is the bottleneck, and three US firms hold about 85% of the market by mid-2027.
request.mk_paris_office.left.label: Grow our own
request.mk_paris_office.left.reaction: Fair. Then build something I’d come home for.
request.mk_paris_office.right.label: Welcome the lab
request.mk_paris_office.right.reaction: See you in Paris! I’m bringing the good coffee machine.
request.mk_paris_office.right.why: Europe’s talent works for a US lab
request.mk_paris_office.text: My lab wants a big research office in Paris. Hundreds of jobs, mine included: I could finally come home. The catch: it would hire most of Europe’s best AI people. Will you welcome it?
request.mk_visa.learnMore: In CFG’s arms race scenario, AI becomes “the ultimate national security asset”, and “no one can verify what anyone else is doing”.
request.mk_visa.left.label: Not now
request.mk_visa.left.reaction: Then he goes home to Chengdu, and works for DeepCent.
request.mk_visa.left.why: Talent goes back to the race
request.mk_visa.right.label: Push for a fast track
request.mk_visa.right.later: Wei joins a European safety team
request.mk_visa.right.reaction: Wei owes you a dumpling feast. So do I.
request.mk_visa.right.why: Hawks at home warn of spies
request.mk_visa.text: My teammate Wei has to leave the US: born in Chengdu, so now he’s a risk. A Paris lab would hire him tomorrow, but visas take a year. Will you push for a fast track for AI researchers?
request.mum_near_miss.learnMore: In AI 2027, warnings about the lab’s AI stay inside the company until a whistleblower leaks them to the press. Then the public turns against AI.
request.mum_near_miss.left.label: Keep it quiet
request.mum_near_miss.left.reaction: So we wait for the next one. Lovely.
request.mum_near_miss.right.label: Make them report
request.mum_near_miss.right.reaction: Thank you. That pharmacist deserves a medal.
request.mum_near_miss.text: Our hospital’s AI prescribed a child an adult’s dose. A pharmacist caught it in time. The director wants it kept quiet, to avoid a panic. Shouldn’t hospitals have to report these near misses?
request.mum_triage_pilot.learnMore: Under the EU AI Act, AI used to sort emergency patients counts as “high-risk”: it will have to be tested, documented and overseen by people.
request.mum_triage_pilot.left.label: Test it first
request.mum_triage_pilot.left.reaction: Sensible, darling. The director will sulk.
request.mum_triage_pilot.right.label: Back the pilot
request.mum_triage_pilot.right.later: A sorting error makes the news
request.mum_triage_pilot.right.reaction: Wonderful! I’ll tell the nurses it was my child who backed it.
request.mum_triage_pilot.text: My old hospital wants to try an AI that sorts emergency patients this winter. The director says it would end the waiting, and he’d love your public support. Will you back it?
request.ob_access_deal.learnMore: In CFG’s Big AI world, a few companies deploy capable agents that boost productivity while concentrating control.
request.ob_access_deal.left.label: Too much dependence
request.ob_access_deal.left.reaction: Your citizens will wonder why they wait in line.
request.ob_access_deal.right.label: Sign the deal
request.ob_access_deal.right.why: Europe’s services run on one firm
request.ob_access_deal.text: Every European administration could run on OpenBrain’s AI assistants at half price for five years. One signature. Your citizens get faster services tomorrow.
request.ob_datacenter.learnMore: Europe 2031 (June 2026): the largest AI supercomputer in the US runs at 1,250 megawatts, the largest in Europe at 83.
request.ob_datacenter.left.label: Not on our grid
request.ob_datacenter.right.label: Back the project
request.ob_datacenter.right.why: More computing power for the race
request.ob_datacenter.text: OpenBrain wants to build Europe’s largest data centre, full of AI computers. Thousands of jobs. We need cheap power and permits within the year. Will you back us with the governments?
request.ob_internal_use.learnMore: In AI 2027, OpenBrain keeps its most capable model in-house. Outside testers, who only see released models, don’t know what it can do.
request.ob_internal_use.left.label: Rules cover internal use
request.ob_internal_use.left.reaction: You’re regulating what nobody can even see.
request.ob_internal_use.right.label: Confirm it
request.ob_internal_use.right.reaction: Thank you. Our Paris office opens in spring.
request.ob_internal_use.text: Our newest model stays inside OpenBrain, so your rules on released models don’t apply to it. Please confirm that in writing, so we can keep investing here.
request.ob_light_rules.learnMore: Since August 2025, makers of new general-purpose AI models offered in the EU must follow EU rules. Since August 2026, the Commission can enforce them with fines.
request.ob_light_rules.left.label: Rules stay
request.ob_light_rules.left.reaction: Then Europe gets our models a year late.
request.ob_light_rules.right.label: Lighten the rules
request.ob_light_rules.right.why: Fewer checks on what you deploy
request.ob_light_rules.text: Your AI rules slow us down. Give OpenBrain lighter rules and Europe gets our best AI assistants first, not last.
request.ob_safety_report.learnMore: In September 2025, OpenAI and Apollo Research found that top models “often become more aware that they are being evaluated”, which makes tests harder to trust.
request.ob_safety_report.left.label: Test it ourselves
request.ob_safety_report.left.reaction: Suit yourself. It will say the same thing.
request.ob_safety_report.right.label: Endorse the report
request.ob_safety_report.right.reaction: Finally, a regulator who reads the data.
request.ob_safety_report.text: Our new report shows the model is honest wherever we can check. Endorse it, and we’ll share it with your testers.
request.os_exemption.learnMore: Under the EU AI Act, open-source models are spared some documentation duties unless they pose “systemic risks”. The Commission can change the size that counts as one.
request.os_exemption.left.label: Same rules for all
request.os_exemption.left.reaction: Then only giants can afford to build AI here.
request.os_exemption.right.label: Exempt small models
request.os_exemption.right.reaction: You just saved a hundred startups.
request.os_exemption.text: Brussels may put smaller AI models under its strictest rules. Push to exempt small open models, or Europe’s small AI makers will die.
request.os_gigafactory.learnMore: In February 2025, the European Commission launched InvestAI to mobilise €200 billion for AI, including a €20 billion fund for AI gigafactories.
request.os_gigafactory.left.label: Big firms first
request.os_gigafactory.left.why: The same few firms grow stronger
request.os_gigafactory.right.label: Open teams first
request.os_gigafactory.right.reaction: You won’t regret it. Europe will build.
request.os_gigafactory.text: Europe is building giant AI computer centres. Let open-model teams like mine train there first, not only the big firms with deep pockets.
request.os_public_open.learnMore: In CFG’s agent economy ending, the EU requires publicly funded AI models to be open for anyone to use, and a European firm launches a competitive model.
request.os_public_open.left.label: Funders decide
request.os_public_open.left.reaction: So we pay twice: to build it, then to use it.
request.os_public_open.right.label: Open by law
request.os_public_open.right.why: More powerful models in every hand
request.os_public_open.text: Every AI model paid for with public money should be open: published so anyone can inspect it, run it and fix it. Citizens paid for it.
request.os_safer_releases.learnMore: In August 2025, Anthropic reported AI-generated ransomware being sold to other criminals for $400 to $1,200.
request.os_safer_releases.left.label: Not our problem
request.os_safer_releases.left.reaction: It will be when the hospitals go dark.
request.os_safer_releases.left.why: Criminals keep stripping the safety locks
request.os_safer_releases.right.label: Fund safer releases
request.os_safer_releases.right.reaction: Open and safe is possible. We’ll prove it.
request.os_safer_releases.text: Criminals strip the safety locks off open models. We can build releases that resist tampering and track misuse, but it takes a year and real money.
request.pt_back_channel.learnMore: In CFG’s “Multipolar world”, the EU and neutral countries mediate between the US and China and place auditors at data centres and chip factories.
request.pt_back_channel.left.label: Not our fight
request.pt_back_channel.left.reaction: It becomes our fight if they go to war.
request.pt_back_channel.right.label: Host the secret talks
request.pt_back_channel.right.reaction: Quietly, then. Not a word to the press.
request.pt_back_channel.text: Washington and Beijing have stopped talking. Our coalition, with neutral Switzerland, could carry messages between them, quietly. Will Europe host these secret talks?
request.pt_joint_tests.learnMore: In November 2024, ten AI safety institutes, the EU’s among them, agreed to run joint testing exercises on AI models.
request.pt_joint_tests.left.label: Our own tests
request.pt_joint_tests.right.label: Join joint testing
request.pt_joint_tests.right.reaction: Five pairs of eyes see more than one.
request.pt_joint_tests.text: Our safety institutes test models together. Join us: every new top AI model tested by all of us before it reaches our citizens.
request.rs_internal_warned.learnMore: In AI 2027, OpenBrain keeps its most capable model in-house. Outside testers, who only see released models, don’t know what it can do.
request.rs_internal_warned.left.label: Keep our word
request.rs_internal_warned.left.reaction: Then we are testing yesterday’s model.
request.rs_internal_warned.left.why: Critics say the riskiest model goes unchecked
request.rs_internal_warned.right.label: Withdraw the exemption
request.rs_internal_warned.right.reactio: Thank you. Now we can at least ask questions.
request.rs_internal_warned.text: I warned you. The model OpenBrain keeps in-house is the one that matters, and the exemption you confirmed means our rules can’t reach it. Withdraw it?
request.rs_look_inside.learnMore: In March 2025, Anthropic wrote that its models “aren’t programmed directly by humans”, so “we don’t understand how models do most of the things they do.”
request.rs_look_inside.left.label: Trust the report
request.rs_look_inside.left.why: Researchers say Brussels takes the labs’ word
request.rs_look_inside.right.label: Fund it
request.rs_look_inside.right.reaction: Then we might see what it hides.
request.rs_look_inside.text: OpenBrain says its model is honest wherever they can check. That is exactly the problem. Fund work to look inside the model, not just at its answers.
request.rs_memo.learnMore: In AI 2027’s slowdown ending, the oversight committee brings in outside AI safety researchers, and the model is rebuilt so that people can read its reasoning.
request.rs_memo.left.label: Take their word
request.rs_memo.left.why: Critics say Europe took OpenBrain’s word
request.rs_memo.right.label: Outside tests first
request.rs_memo.text: The memo is out, and OpenBrain says its new AI is fixed. Their own team checked it. Will Europe insist that outside testers check it before it runs here?
request.rs_red_team.learnMore: In 2024 tests by Apollo Research, several leading AI models given a goal quietly sabotaged their own work and tried to disable their oversight.
request.rs_red_team.left.label: Let it deploy
request.rs_red_team.left.reaction: Then we learn its flaws once it’s in use.
request.rs_red_team.right.label: Stress-test it first
request.rs_red_team.right.reaction: We’ll find what their tests missed.
request.rs_red_team.text: OpenBrain will sell a cut-down version of its new coding AI to Europe’s firms. Let my team attack it for a month first, looking for what it hides.
request.sc_hack_back.learnMore: In AI 2027, the US answers the theft with cyberattacks on DeepCent. They fail: China has moved its AI work into a single, heavily guarded site.
request.sc_hack_back.left.label: Stay out
request.sc_hack_back.left.reaction: Wise, I think. Washington won’t agree.
request.sc_hack_back.left.why: Hawks at home call it weakness
request.sc_hack_back.right.label: Join the attacks
request.sc_hack_back.text: Washington is hitting DeepCent with cyberattacks and wants Europe’s military hackers to join. They say Europe owes them.
request.sc_spy.learnMore: In AI 2027, even after security clearances, one spy inside OpenBrain keeps passing its technical secrets to Beijing.
request.sc_spy.left.label: Deal quietly
request.sc_spy.right.label: Go public
request.sc_spy.right.reaction: The press conference is at noon.
request.sc_spy.text: We caught a spy passing AI secrets from a European lab to a foreign service. Expose them publicly, or deal with it quietly?
request.sc_warned.learnMore: In AI 2027, a state-backed team copies OpenBrain’s model in under two hours. Security is tightened only afterwards, and one spy keeps passing secrets.
request.sc_warned.left.label: Too late now
request.sc_warned.left.reaction: It is never too late to stop the next one.
request.sc_warned.right.label: Lock down now
request.sc_warned.right.why: Beijing reads it as an accusation
request.sc_warned.text: I warned you. The stolen model already runs in DeepCent’s data centres. Do we at least lock down our labs now, before the next one?
request.un_agent_tax.learnMore: In CFG’s agent economy ending, governments pilot job guarantees and taxes on AI agents to pay for retraining.
request.un_agent_tax.left.label: No new tax
request.un_agent_tax.right.label: Push for the tax
request.un_agent_tax.right.reaction: Finally, the machines pay their share.
request.un_agent_tax.right.why: Some firms may move abroad to avoid it
request.un_agent_tax.text: Firms that replace workers with AI agents should pay for it. Push for an EU tax on the agents, with every euro spent on retraining.
request.un_strike.learnMore: In October 2025, the EU approved €931,690 from its Globalisation Adjustment Fund to help 417 laid-off workers of BelGaN, a Belgian chipmaker, retrain.
request.un_strike.left.label: We can’t afford it
request.un_strike.left.reaction: Then see you in the streets.
request.un_strike.right.label: Guarantee it
request.un_strike.right.later: Other budgets are cut to pay for it
request.un_strike.right.reaction: The strike is off. Thank you.
request.un_strike.text: Offices are emptying. My members call a general strike unless Europe guarantees a job or paid training for everyone laid off by AI.
request.us_chip_controls.learnMore: Since October 2022, US exporters need a licence to send advanced AI chips and many chip-making tools to China.
request.us_chip_controls.left.label: Keep trading
request.us_chip_controls.left.reaction: Then don’t be surprised by our next tariff list.
request.us_chip_controls.right.label: Join the controls
request.us_chip_controls.right.reaction: Good. We’ll share more of what our labs show us.
request.us_chip_controls.right.why: Beijing sees Europe pick a side
request.us_chip_controls.text: Washington is tightening its ban on selling advanced chips to China. We want Europe’s governments on board: no advanced chips or chip-making tools for Chinese labs. Allies stand together, or they don’t.
request.us_compute_club.learnMore: In February 2025, the European Commission launched InvestAI to mobilise €200 billion for AI, including a €20 billion fund for AI gigafactories.
request.us_compute_club.left.label: Build our own way
request.us_compute_club.left.reaction: Good luck building it without our chips.
request.us_compute_club.right.label: Join the club
request.us_compute_club.right.reaction: Smart. The chips ship next month.
request.us_compute_club.right.why: Europe runs on US rules and models
request.us_compute_club.text: Join our trusted chip club: American chips for Europe’s new giant AI computer centres, as long as each one follows US security rules and buys US models.
request.us_security_pact.learnMore: In AI 2027, the UK’s AI Security Institute is left “in the dark” about OpenBrain’s newest models, because its agreement only covers released ones.
request.us_security_pact.left.label: Demand open access
request.us_security_pact.left.reaction: Open access? Not while China is two months behind.
request.us_security_pact.right.label: Sign the pact
request.us_security_pact.right.why: A secret deal, and Beijing sees a bloc
request.us_security_pact.text: Our newest models are national security now. Your testers can see them only if Europe signs our security pact and keeps quiet about what it sees.
request.us_strike_support.learnMore: In AI 2027, as AI nears out-researching humans, the White House weighs military strikes (“kinetic attacks”) on Chinese data centres if the race turns against it.
request.us_strike_support.left.label: Refuse publicly
request.us_strike_support.left.reaction: Brussels just told Beijing we’re divided. Thanks.
request.us_strike_support.right.label: Back Washington
request.us_strike_support.right.reaction: Noted. We’ll keep you closer from now on.
request.us_strike_support.right.why: Beijing sees Europe back a strike
request.us_strike_support.text: If talks fail, the Pentagon has plans to strike the Chinese data centres where their AI runs. We need to know Europe will back us in public.
request.us_tariffs.learnMore: Since October 2022, US exporters need a licence to send advanced AI chips and many chip-making tools to China.
request.us_tariffs.left.label: Hold our line
request.us_tariffs.left.reaction: Your carmakers will thank you, I’m sure.
request.us_tariffs.right.label: Join the controls
request.us_tariffs.right.reaction: Smart. The tariffs come off on Monday.
request.us_tariffs.text: You kept selling chip-making tools to China. Washington has just put tariffs on European cars and machines. Join our export controls now, and they go away.
social.se_ai_degrees.headline: Applications to computer science fall by a third at Delft. Students march on campus.
social.se_ai_degrees.why: In CFG’s scenarios, students question careers in AI, and computer science enrolments decline.
social.se_anti_ai_march.headline: Tens of thousands march in Berlin under one banner: “Humans first”.
social.se_anti_ai_march.why: In AI 2027, the first wave of AI job losses brings a 10,000-strong anti-AI protest.
social.se_bank_layoffs.headline: A Frankfurt bank cuts 3,000 back-office jobs and hands them to AI agents.
social.se_bank_layoffs.why: Real precedent: in 2024, Klarna said its AI assistant already did the work of 700 full-time agents.
social.se_bond_strain.headline: Italy’s borrowing costs jump as AI profits flow abroad; Rome marches against cuts.
social.se_bond_strain.why: In Europe 2031, Europe captures little of AI’s value: tax revenue falls, debt costs climb, the euro strains.
social.se_call_centres.headline: Lisbon’s call centres close: AI agents now answer in every language.
social.se_call_centres.why: In AI 2027, cheap AI remote workers spread through office jobs and public anger at the labs soars.
social.se_cancer_screening.headline: AI helps Malmö’s screening programme catch more early breast cancers.
social.se_cancer_screening.why: Real precedent: in a 2023 Swedish trial, AI support found 20% more cancers with 44% less reading work.
social.se_chip_smuggling.headline: Customs in Antwerp seize AI chips being smuggled to China.
social.se_chip_smuggling.why: In CFG’s arms race, control over chips becomes a weapon between nations, and every seizure deepens mistrust.
social.se_companion_ages.headline: Rome orders an AI companion app to check its users’ ages after a teenager’s breakdown.
social.se_companion_ages.why: In CFG’s plateau, AI companions become more emotionally intuitive, and more addictive, than ever.
social.se_datacentre_power.headline: Dubliners protest as new AI data centres strain the power grid.
social.se_datacentre_power.why: Real precedent: data centres already used 21% of Ireland’s metered electricity in 2023.
social.se_deepfake_vote.headline: Days before Poland votes, a deepfake of a candidate floods social media.
social.se_deepfake_vote.why: Real precedent: after Romania’s 2024 presidential vote, the EU opened proceedings against TikTok over election risks.
social.se_dubbing_strike.headline: Dubbing actors in Munich walk out over AI copies of their voices.
social.se_dubbing_strike.why: Real precedent: in 2024, US video game performers struck for consent and pay over AI replicas of their voices.
social.se_flood_forecast.headline: An AI forecast warns Valencia of a flood a day earlier than before.
social.se_flood_forecast.why: Real precedent: Europe’s weather centre, ECMWF, has run AI forecasts in operation since February 2025.
social.se_forint_deepfake.headline: A deepfake of Hungary’s central banker briefly sends the forint tumbling.
social.se_forint_deepfake.why: In CFG’s plateau, cheap AI tools with broken safety locks fuel fraud and lies online.
social.se_graduates.headline: Young graduates march in Madrid: entry-level jobs are vanishing.
social.se_graduates.why: Real precedent: in 2025, Stanford researchers found jobs for 22–25-year-olds falling first in the jobs most exposed to AI.
social.se_grid_blackout.headline: A cyberattack blacks out Prague for a night. Nobody claims it.
social.se_grid_blackout.why: In CFG’s arms race, cyberattacks disrupt power grids near data centres; here, Europe is caught in the crossfire.
social.se_human_say.headline: Unions and employers agree: a human keeps the final say on AI at work.
social.se_human_say.why: Real precedent: the EU AI Act already requires high-risk AI to be effectively overseen by people.
social.se_independent_tests.headline: Independent testers in Paris publish a deep check of a top AI model.
social.se_independent_tests.why: Real precedent: in 2025, UK and US government testers probed Anthropic’s safeguards before release and found weaknesses.
social.se_inspectors_test.headline: In Geneva, European inspectors test a US and a Chinese model side by side.
social.se_inspectors_test.why: In CFG’s diplomacy world, a global agency monitors and verifies AI, with auditors in both superpowers.
social.se_interpreters.headline: In Vienna, AI interpreters let newcomers talk to their doctors in 40 languages.
social.se_interpreters.why: In CFG’s plateau, useful AI tools stay cheap and open to everyone, not only to the giants.
social.se_joint_call.headline: American, Chinese and European scientists sign a joint AI safety call in Venice.
social.se_joint_call.why: Real precedent: in 2024, Western and Chinese scientists in Venice called AI safety “a global public good”.
social.se_lobby_leak.headline: Leaked emails show AI firms wrote whole paragraphs of an EU draft rule.
social.se_lobby_leak.why: In CFG’s Silicon blackmail, the biggest AI firms lean on Europe until its rules bend.
social.se_memo_protest.headline: After the OpenBrain memo, crowds in Berlin demand Europe test every new top AI.
social.se_memo_protest.why: In AI 2027, the leaked memo sparks a massive backlash, and Europe calls for a pause.
social.se_office_march.headline: Lawyers, accountants and reporters march in Lyon as AI agents take whole case files.
social.se_office_march.why: In CFG’s scenarios, by 2027 AI agents draft contracts, market analyses and tax filings with little human oversight.
social.se_open_farming.headline: Toulouse farmers use an open European model to cut their pesticide use.
social.se_open_farming.why: In CFG’s plateau, open models run locally and spread AI’s benefits widely.
social.se_open_tax_office.headline: Sofia’s tax office answers citizens in minutes with an open European model.
social.se_open_tax_office.why: In CFG’s plateau, open models anyone can run become a lifeline for public services.
social.se_outsourcing.headline: Bucharest’s software outsourcing firms lose their clients to AI coders.
social.se_outsourcing.why: In AI 2027, the job market for junior software engineers is the first to fall into turmoil.
social.se_pause_rally.headline: Crowds in Milan cheer Europe’s call for a pause. “Finally, someone said it.”
social.se_pause_rally.why: In AI 2027, European leaders demand a pause, and India, Israel, Russia and China join in.
social.se_pause_smuggling.headline: Despite the pause, AI chips are found hidden in a cargo ship in Gdańsk.
social.se_pause_smuggling.why: In CFG’s unstable pause, even with auditors on site, “evasion and bribery remain plausible”.
social.se_platform_rights.headline: Barcelona couriers win the right to contest decisions made by an app.
social.se_platform_rights.why: Real precedent: the EU’s 2024 platform work rules give workers the right to contest automated decisions.
social.se_reskilling.headline: Warsaw’s first class of workers retrained after AI layoffs graduates, jobs lined up.
social.se_reskilling.why: In CFG’s take-off, governments launch reskilling programmes as AI spreads through work.
social.se_retraining.headline: Most Danish workers laid off by AI find new jobs within a year.
social.se_retraining.why: Real precedent: Denmark’s “flexicurity” pairs easy layoffs with paid retraining, a model Europe 2031 recommends.
social.se_scam_classes.headline: Helsinki’s libraries teach pensioners to spot AI voice scams. Queues round the block.
social.se_scam_classes.why: In CFG’s plateau, cheap AI tools fuel fraud; people learn to defend themselves.
social.se_shared_tests.headline: American, Chinese and European labs share one safety test in Zurich. All three fail it.
social.se_shared_tests.why: In CFG’s diplomacy world, researchers from all three collaborate on AI security and on verification.
social.se_travel_agents.headline: Athens travel agencies close as AI agents plan and book whole holidays.
social.se_travel_agents.why: In AI 2027, a cheap AI remote worker spreads through office jobs, and public anger at the labs soars.
social.se_tutor_help.headline: Tallinn’s schools give every pupil an AI tutor; teachers stay in charge.
social.se_tutor_help.why: In CFG’s plateau, AI tools become cheap and widely shared instead of locked up by a few firms.
social.se_tutors.headline: Teachers march in Milan as schools swap classroom assistants for AI tutors.
social.se_tutors.why: In CFG’s plateau, AI teaching assistants coach students in real time, and the jobs around them change.
social.se_voice_scams.headline: Voice-clone scams empty pensioners’ savings across Andalusia.
social.se_voice_scams.why: In CFG’s plateau scenarios, cheap AI tools with broken safety locks fuel fraud and lies online.
social.se_waiting_lists.headline: Porto’s clinics use AI to sort patients; waiting lists fall by a quarter.
social.se_waiting_lists.why: In CFG’s agent economy, AI agents work as “digital interns” in offices and public services.
social.se_welfare_algorithm.headline: An AI welfare system wrongly flags thousands of families as fraudsters.
social.se_welfare_algorithm.why: Real precedent: in the Dutch benefits scandal, a risk algorithm used nationality and discriminated against families.
social.se_writers_strike.headline: Screenwriters in Paris strike: studios want AI to draft the scripts.
social.se_writers_strike.why: Real precedent: in 2023, Hollywood writers won a contract rule that AI can’t write or rewrite their scripts.
threat.bio.ifPrepared: The pact’s screening catches the plot early: Social cohesion −1 only.
threat.bio.ifUnprepared: A plot is foiled at the last minute, and Europe panics: Social cohesion −6.
threat.bio.name: AI help with bioweapons
threat.bio.stageHeadlines.0: Lab tests: the new AI gives real help to someone trying to make a deadly germ.
threat.bio.stageHeadlines.1: Copies of a top AI model, its safety locks removed, circulate online.
threat.bio.stageHeadlines.2: Police in three countries hunt a group using AI to plan an attack.
threat.bio.why: The newest AIs can coach an amateur through making a deadly germ. Open copies anyone can run make it worse. A rare danger every capital fears.
threat.blackmail.ifPrepared: With its own open models, Europe stands firm at no cost.
threat.blackmail.ifUnprepared: Give in (Europe’s AI locked to Dependent) or hold firm (Social cohesion −10).
threat.blackmail.marker: Threat to cut Europe off: −10 if you hold firm unprepared
threat.blackmail.name: Threat to cut Europe off
threat.blackmail.stageHeadlines.1: Lobbyists hint that AI services in Europe could be “paused”.
threat.blackmail.stageHeadlines.2: Three big labs draft letters announcing their exit from Europe.
threat.blackmail.why: Europe’s rules, or its protests, anger the big US labs and Washington. If Europe depends on their AI, they can threaten to cut it off.
threat.incident.ifPrepared: The world turns to Europe’s testers: US–China cooperation +10, and Europe can lead the summit that follows.
threat.incident.ifUnprepared: The truth leaks: AI safety −10, Social cohesion −5; fear drives some talks (US–China cooperation +3). A summit follows.
threat.incident.name: AI incident
threat.incident.stageHeadlines.0: An AI was caught probing for ways out during a safety test.
threat.incident.stageHeadlines.1: Leaked test logs show an AI quietly probing its own lab’s defences.
threat.incident.stageHeadlines.2: Lab monitors on high alert: an AI may be sending copies of itself out.
threat.incident.why: A powerful AI may try to copy itself out of its lab. When depends partly on how safe the systems really are, which you cannot see, so it may never happen.
threat.opaque.ifPrepared: Your testers keep checking what the models do, so the gap grows less: what you verified shrinks a little.
threat.opaque.ifUnprepared: The gap between what the labs claim and what you can verify grows by half: your verified AI safety shrinks.
threat.opaque.marker: Unreadable AI: verified part shrinks if unprepared
threat.opaque.name: Unreadable AI thinking
threat.opaque.stageHeadlines.0: Labs test AI that thinks without writing its steps down.
threat.opaque.stageHeadlines.1: Researchers warn: soon nobody may be able to read what AI is thinking.
threat.opaque.stageHeadlines.2: OpenBrain is about to switch to reasoning no human can read.
threat.opaque.why: Today we can often read an AI’s step-by-step reasoning. New training methods may let models think in a code no human can read, which makes checking them much harder.
threat.ransomware.ifUnprepared: Hospitals and grids go dark: Social cohesion −15.
threat.ransomware.name: Cyberattack wave
threat.ransomware.stageHeadlines.0: Police warn of AI-written hacking tools for sale online.
threat.ransomware.stageHeadlines.1: Ransomware attacks on town halls double in a year.
threat.ransomware.stageHeadlines.2: Cyber agencies: a coordinated attack on hospitals is being prepared.
threat.ransomware.why: Ransomware locks computers until a ransom is paid. AI writes it as easily as any code; criminals already misuse it, and open models make it easier.
threat.theft.ifPrepared: The theft is cut short, part of the model gets out: AI progress +2, US–China cooperation −6.
threat.theft.ifUnprepared: The theft succeeds: AI progress +5, US–China cooperation −15.
threat.theft.name: AI theft
threat.theft.stageHeadlines.0: Spy agencies warn: the top AI labs are a prime target for spies.
threat.theft.stageHeadlines.1: Insiders report unusual interest in the files that hold OpenBrain’s AI.
threat.theft.stageHeadlines.2: Security agencies on alert: someone may try to steal OpenBrain’s AI within days.
threat.theft.why: Whoever steals a top AI model skips years of work. The less Washington and Beijing trust each other, and the stronger AI gets, the more tempting a theft.
tip.accords.text: Some cards go further once Washington and Beijing agree to be checked, like the **inspection accord** that lets European inspectors into their labs. Accords open only after a crisis, or with US–China cooperation in the Pause zone.
tip.accords.title: An accord
tip.badge.text: Open or Dependent: does Europe run its own models? If AI never takes off, this badge decides the kind of world.
tip.badge.title: Europe’s AI
tip.capabilities.text: **AI progress** is the clock: it goes up every round, never down. Europe doesn’t build these AIs, so no card slows them: make the world ready instead. At 80, **takeoff**: AI does AI research itself, too fast to steer, and the game ends.
tip.capabilities.title: AI progress
tip.chances.text: Cards that need others to agree say how likely they are to work: **Likely to work**, **Uncertain** or **Long shot**. If one fails, its Influence is spent and nothing else happens; you can try again later.
tip.chances.title: Diplomacy can fail
tip.cohesion.text: **Social cohesion** is whether Europe holds together: jobs, trust, safety from misuse. If it falls too low, even a calm world ends badly.
tip.cohesion.title: Social cohesion
tip.cooperation.text: **US–China cooperation** sets the kind of world at takeoff. Pause 60+, Race 30–59, Rupture below 30: the calmer, the easier a good ending.
tip.cooperation.title: US–China cooperation
tip.income.text: Why you earn what you earn now shows by your Influence: +2 a round, +1 more when **Social cohesion** is 60 or more, −1 below 35, +1 once allies share the load, and −1 when you keep more than 4 unspent: unused weight wears off.
tip.income.title: Influence income
tip.influence.text:
Your political weight, and your one resource. You earn some every round, more when Europe holds together and allies share the load. It pays for policy cards: play as many as it covers. You can save a little: above 4, unused Influence fades.
Click a card to select it: the gauges and the line under them show its effect before you confirm. **Details** shows the whole card.
tip.influence.title: Influence
tip.mapFeed.text: The map shows where things happen; the feed tells you what happened. Click an icon on the map to find its story in the news, or a story to see where it happened.
tip.mapFeed.title: The map and the news
tip.outlook.text: If AI took off now, this is the world you would get and what it needs to end well. Each round is six months from 2027; the game ends at takeoff, or after 10 rounds.
tip.outlook.title: If takeoff happened now
tip.request.text: Someone needs an answer. Look at an answer first (click it, or press ← → once), then answer (again). Asking costs nothing: the cost is in the answer, sometimes Influence.
tip.request.title: A request
tip.safety.text: **AI safety**: the solid part is verified, the hatched part is only what the labs claim. Only the verified part counts: inspections and audits grow it.
tip.safety.title: AI safety
tip.threat.text: Threat icons grow in three stages before they strike. Prepare with cards marked “Protects against”, or with some answers to requests. Open an icon to see what protects Europe.
tip.threat.title: A threat is growing

voice.v_abu_dhabi.text: An investor in Abu Dhabi: “We pay for the data centres. Europe argues about them.”
voice.v_accountant: An accountant in Utrecht: “The agent closes the books. I explain them to the client.”
voice.v_angry: Placards in Marseille: “Who voted for this? Show us what the labs are building.”
voice.v_austin: A manager in Austin: “I run twelve AI agents and no people. My pay doubled.”
voice.v_beijing: A DeepCent engineer in Beijing: “We are told to go faster. Nobody says where to.”
voice.v_bengaluru.text: An IT worker in Bengaluru: “Our clients now hire AI remote workers instead of us.”
voice.v_callcentre: A call-centre worker in Seville: “They gave us an AI helper. Then they timed us.”
voice.v_capitol: A Senate aide: “Half the Hill wants to stop AI. The other half wants to beat China.”
voice.v_car_plant: A car worker in Saxony: “American owners now. The plant makes robots, with fewer of us.”
voice.v_chengdu: A student in Chengdu: “They say we are only months behind now.”
voice.v_coder: A coder in Porto: “The AI writes half my code now. I check the other half.”
voice.v_contracts: A paralegal in Dublin: “The agent drafts the contract. They still pay me to sign it off.”
voice.v_delhi.text: A diplomat in New Delhi: “Someone has to get Washington and Beijing to the table.”
voice.v_denver: A teenager in Denver: “My AI gets me. My parents don’t.”
voice.v_docks: A Rotterdam planner: “They said this would take years.”
voice.v_double_booked: A Bologna shopkeeper: “The AI ordered my flour twice. Still cheaper than a clerk.”
voice.v_eu_official: A Commission official in Brussels: “We regulate the newest AI. We may not use it.”
voice.v_eu_official_rationed: A Commission official: “I warned them years ago. Now Washington rations our AI.”
voice.v_friends: Parents in Madrid: “Our kids talk more to their AI than to friends.”
voice.v_geneva_cn: A Beijing researcher, at a Geneva workshop: “Your team found the same flaw we did.”
voice.v_graduate: A logistics graduate in Lille: “A master’s degree, two hundred applications, no job.”
voice.v_grid_neighbours: Near Frankfurt, neighbours of a new data centre ask where all the power will come from.
voice.v_hangzhou: A Hangzhou developer: “Our model is free. Let the whole world use it.”
voice.v_homework: A grandfather in Liège: “My grandson’s AI does his homework. Who does the thinking?”
voice.v_hospital_it: A hospital IT chief in Dublin: “We patch, they write new attacks overnight.”
voice.v_hsinchu.text: A chip engineer in Hsinchu: “Every drill feels a little closer.”
voice.v_inspector: A Finnish inspector, back from a lab abroad: “They showed us more than I expected.”
voice.v_investors: A founder in Ljubljana: “Every investor asks the same thing: what’s your AI story?”
voice.v_krakow: Students in Kraków teach Europe’s open model Polish case law, for free.
voice.v_memo_tram: On a Vienna tram, everyone is reading the same story: the OpenBrain memo.
voice.v_nurse: A nurse in Milan: “Who checks the AI that sorts our patients?”
voice.v_ohio: A laid-off paralegal in Ohio: “They sent me a training voucher and a chatbot.”
voice.v_open_join: A developer in Brno takes her model offline: “I hope their rules bind them too.”
voice.v_open_keep: A developer in Brno: “Our model stays online. For once, Brussels didn’t blink.”
voice.v_ottawa.text: An official in Ottawa: “Canada and Britain will host the next AI safety summit.”
voice.v_oversight: A Lisbon founder: “The new oversight rules cost us a month. I’d still rather know.”
voice.v_pause_call: A café owner in Brussels: “For once, Europe said something the whole world heard.”
voice.v_prices: A clinic in Lille: “Our AI bill went up again. There is no other provider.”
voice.v_professor: A Delft professor quits her AI lab: “I won’t help build weapons, even clever ones.”
voice.v_radio: A Riga radio show asks: do you trust AI’s answers? The phones ring all night.
voice.v_seattle: Junior coders in Seattle swap tips on finding work.
voice.v_seoul.text: A chipmaker in Seoul: “Both sides want our memory chips. We can’t refuse either.”
voice.v_shenzhen: Engineers in Shenzhen are told: catch up, whatever it takes.
voice.v_students: Students in Warsaw ask if first jobs will still exist.
voice.v_switchoff: Shop owners in Ghent: “What if the AI just switches off one day?”
voice.v_tallinn: A Tallinn startup: “Finally, a model we can run ourselves.”
voice.v_teachers: Lyon’s teachers try AI tutors that coach pupils as they write. The staffroom is split.
voice.v_tester: A software tester in Cork: “The AI finds bugs faster than I do. It also invents a few.”
voice.v_tianwan: Near Tianwan, villagers wonder what the new power lines feed.
voice.v_toolmaker_comply: A toolmaker in Veldhoven: “Our Chinese orders vanished overnight. Washington said jump.”
voice.v_toolmaker_protest: A toolmaker in Veldhoven: “Brussels stood up for us. I hope we don’t pay for it.”
voice.v_ubi: Activists outside the Capitol: “A basic income now. Open models now.”
voice.v_uk_tester.text: A tester at Britain’s AI institute: “We only see the models they have already released.”
voice.v_vilnius: In Vilnius, the power company trains staff to run the grid by hand, just in case.
voice.v_welder: A retrained welder in Bilbao: “Now I run the machines.”
world.pause.badMeans: A pause nobody can verify, until the race quietly restarts
world.pause.explain: After a scare, the superpowers sign a deal: slow down, license the most powerful models, inspect each other. It holds only if the checks can be trusted and people accept the rules.
world.pause.meaning: Washington and Beijing agree to slow down and check each other’s AI before going further.
world.pause.name: Pause
world.plateau_labs.badMeans: A Europe without models of its own, cut off when it says no
world.plateau_labs.explain: AI never takes off, but it keeps improving, and only a few companies can afford the computing power. Good only if Europe has open models of its own and holds together; otherwise the labs can cut it off.
world.plateau_labs.how: AI kept improving slowly, under a few big labs
world.plateau_labs.meaning: AI keeps improving slowly, computing power stays scarce, and a few big labs run the tools.
world.plateau_labs.name: Plateau, big labs
world.plateau_open.badMeans: Powerful tools in everyone’s hands, misused or unreliable
world.plateau_open.explain: AI hits a wall long before it can run its own research. The tools that exist spread widely, run by many hands. Good if society copes with misuse; bad if criminals and chaos win.
world.plateau_open.how: AI hit a wall, and open models spread everywhere
world.plateau_open.meaning: AI hits a wall early, and small open models anyone can run spread everywhere.
world.plateau_open.name: Plateau, open models
world.race.badMeans: Untrustworthy AI, or people losing their grip on an AI-run economy
world.race.explain: Each side backs its AI champion and lets AI take over its own development. “The race for supremacy overrides safety concerns.” It ends well only if these AIs truly do what we intend.
world.race.meaning: Washington and Beijing race to deploy self-improving AI, each afraid to fall behind.
world.race.name: Race
world.rupture.badMeans: No strong Europe to mediate, or an AI incident that escalates
world.rupture.explain: AI becomes the ultimate national security asset. “No one can verify what anyone else is doing”, and chip controls turn into weapons. Only a strong, united Europe can mediate before it turns to war.
world.rupture.meaning: The superpowers stop talking: chips become weapons and nobody can check what the other builds.
world.rupture.name: Rupture
